question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s entrenched control over the Chinese Communist Party and military, reinforced by ongoing purges of senior officials through 2026, underpins the 95.5% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. No designated successor has emerged, term limits were previously abolished, and analysts view the expected 21st Party Congress in late 2027 as likely to extend his leadership rather than trigger transition. Recent purges of Politburo and Central Military Commission figures are interpreted as tools to enforce loyalty rather than signals of vulnerability. While sudden health developments, unforeseen elite backlash, or major external shocks could still shift dynamics before the end of 2026, current institutional dominance and absence of credible challenges sustain the strong market pricing.
